name: Lens
description: One line in any note draws a live table of what a query holds, relative to that note: columns, computed columns, sums, groups, and cells that press to change a property.

scripts.name: lens
scripts.about: lens:: query="type=meeting when={{this.page}}" columns=title,when,status edit=status sort=when — a live table, drawn where the line is

scripts.name: lens-set
scripts.about: lens-set note=<id> key=status value=done, or next=1 to step to the next value: what a lens cell's press runs
